title: add_helm_value
description: Adds or updates a value in a Helm chart's values.yaml file at the specified key path.

chart_path.description: Path to the Helm chart directory or the specific values file to modify (e.g. 'charts/my-app', 'deploy/helm/values.yaml').

key.description: Dot-separated key path within the values file where the value should be set (e.g. 'replicaCount', 'ingress.enabled', 'resources.limits.memory').

value.description: The value to set at the specified key. Scalars are written directly; complex types should be serialized as a YAML string.
